visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair is wearing a thick, fuzzy brown scarf with bear ears on the hood over a pink sweater. She smiles and gestures with her hands against a plain white studio background. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of her face as she holds a Maybelline Superstay Teddy Tint lipstick tube near her mouth, displaying a soft pink lip color. (3) She presents three tubes of the product to the camera while smiling. (4) Multiple chronological phases follow where she showcases different lip shades: #25 is a nude peach, #30 is a rose red while she holds a small red plush bear, #35 is a vibrant strawberry red while she cuddles the plush bear, and #60 is a dusty rose shade while she holds a pink bear-shaped lollipop. (5) A demonstration phase shows a close-up of her lips as she applies the liquid lipstick with an applicator and blends it with her finger. (6) She showcases shade #75, a coral orange, and bites into the pink bear lollipop. (7) A close-up shot shows six swatches of the lipstick on a pale arm, each labeled with a number and name in white text. (8) The final phase features her holding two red plush bears, smiling and winking at the camera while promoting a limited-time offer.
